personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for Android Landscape Tablet Kiosk)
personality_one_liner: A premium, distraction-free, and highly reliable digital signage player built for stability and clean aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing optimized for a landscape tablet display. Use padding to keep content centered and prevent cards from stretching too wide.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism. This is a low-overhead signage player app that needs maximum performance and a flat, clean card style.

screens.name: Registration
screens.purpose: First-launch screen to pair the physical tablet with a QwickAds cloud account using a registration code.

states.loading: Disable inputs and show spinner inside the primary button.
states.error: Inline error text below the input field in error color.

screens.layout: Centered layout on landscape screen. Wrap the content in a clean, white `surfaceSecondary` card (max-width ~500px, large radius `lg`, shadow tier 1) sitting on a `surface` background. Show a premium 'QwickAds Power' text/logo at the top, followed by instructions, a large text input for the Registration Code, and a full-width 'Activate Screen' primary CTA button.

screens.name: Player

states.error: Do not show errors here. Continue looping cached content or fallback screen.

screens.layout: Pure `surfaceInverse` (#000000) background. Completely hide system status bar and home indicator if possible (use expo-navigation-bar / expo-status-bar). Content is just an edge-to-edge Image or Video. No overlays, no buttons, no margins.

screens.name: Maintenance (PIN Gate & Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Hidden configuration and recovery screen accessed via 5 corner taps, requiring a PIN before allowing destructive actions.

states.loading: Spinner over action buttons when syncing.
states.error: Error toast or inline red text if PIN is wrong or sync fails.

screens.layout: PIN Gate: Centered modal over a dark overlay. Main Dashboard: 2-column landscape grid. Left column: Device details (Screen ID, Cab Number, Area, Version, Storage) presented as a list of clean, read-only rows. Right column: Action buttons (Sync Now, Clear Cache, Reconnect, Exit Player). Destructive actions must be clearly marked (e.g., outlined red or solid red). Use a header with 'Maintenance Mode' and a close button to return to Player.

screens.name: Fallback Waiting
screens.purpose: Displayed when there is no cached ad content available to play.

states.loading: Continuous soft pulse animation on the logo.

screens.layout: Centered content on `surfaceSecondary` or `surface`. Show a QwickAds branded graphic, a spinner or loading pulse, and 'Waiting for advertising content...' text. Simple, elegant, and reassuring to the passenger.

instructions_to_main_agent: This app is an ALWAYS-ON KIOSK. Prioritize reliability. There is no traditional navigation header (hide the stack header).
Lock the orientation to LANDSCAPE in app.json or via expo-screen-orientation.
The Player screen MUST be completely distraction-free. No safe area insets padding the ad content; it should fill the screen. Background must be black.
For the hidden maintenance screen trigger, implement a transparent Pressable in one corner (e.g., top-left) on the Player screen that counts to 5 taps within a short time window.
Design the Registration card to look spacious and premium, avoiding stretching across the entire width of the landscape tablet. Restrict its max-width (e.g., 500px).
Do not use glassmorphism or expensive blurs. This app needs high performance for video/image cycling.

For the QwickAds branding, use the `brandPrimary` purple (#6B46C1) alongside crisp typography. A text-based 'QwickAds Power' wordmark with heavy font weight (500 per our rules) is sufficient if a logo image is unavailable.
Ensure 'Clear Cache' and 'Exit Player' buttons in the Maintenance screen require the PIN input or at least have a distinct, cautious visual styling (like an error-colored outline).
